sampling_recommendations.description: Prioritized list of properties that need more evidence. Empty array if all properties are well-covered.

property_name.description: Name of the property that needs sampling.

missing_extreme.description: Which extreme of the gradient has insufficient evidence.

current_evidence_count.description: Number of incidents currently at this extreme.

priority.description: Sampling priority. critical = 0 cases, high theoretical importance. low = may be marked as limitation.

theoretical_importance.description: How important this property is to the emerging theory.

importance_rationale.description: Why this property has this importance level (cited in hypotheses, distinguishes types, peripheral, etc.).

what_to_look_for.description: Concrete description of what behavioral manifestation to look for. What would the missing extreme look like in practice?

participant_profile.description: Type of participant or context where this extreme would likely manifest.

suggested_interview_question.description: Concrete question or probe to elicit the missing extreme in new data collection.

search_in_existing_corpus.description: true if existing documents may already contain the missing extreme (suggest searching before collecting new data).

search_criteria.description: If search_in_existing_corpus=true: keywords or concepts to search for in existing segments.

mark_as_limitation.description: true if this gap is likely irresolvable in the current population and should be documented as a study limitation.

limitation_rationale.description: If mark_as_limitation=true: why this gap cannot be resolved.

saturated_properties.description: Properties that are well-covered at both extremes. For reference only.

evidence_summary.description: Brief summary of evidence at each extreme.

overall_saturation_assessment.description: Narrative assessment: is this category close to saturation? What's holding it back? 2-4 sentences.

estimated_iterations_to_saturation.description: Estimated number of additional document iterations needed. -1 if cannot estimate.

sampling_strategy_note.description: Free note for the researcher: overarching strategy for completing saturation of this category.
